changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Permit a review job to be cancelled because a newer occasion of its item replaced its review before it started.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review_job DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_cancellation;

ALTER TABLE review_job ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_cancellation CHECK(cancellation_reason IS NULL OR cancellation_reason IN ('DRAIN_GRACEFUL','DRAIN_IMMEDIATE','BUDGET_EXHAUSTED','MODEL_UNAVAILABLE','MEMBER_AI_DECLINED','PERSON_DATA_ERASED','CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN','CANCELLED_BY_REQUESTER','CONTRACT_CHANGED','NO_SANDBOX_ROOM','REPLACED'));
